name: typed-ffmpeg
role: Typed Python and experimental TypeScript APIs for building FFmpeg commands
notes: 2026-11-15: Assess because typed filtergraph construction could reduce hand-written FFmpeg command errors. Revisit after checking TypeScript package maturity and official supported-filter coverage.
2026-11-15: Assessment uncertainty: release recency and complete TypeScript supported-filter/version coverage were not established; TypeScript route is documented as experimental.
summary: Typed Python API and experimental TypeScript packages construct FFmpeg commands and filtergraphs with filter types, documentation and compile-to-argument output. The library helps author pipelines but does not include FFmpeg; execution still depends on a compatible system FFmpeg binary.
use_when: Build FFmpeg filtergraphs with typed Python APIs and IDE support
Use TypeScript bindings when their experimental maturity is acceptable
Generate FFmpeg arguments in code rather than hand-writing filtergraph strings
avoid_when: Use ffmpeg-ffprobe directly for simple CLI commands and probing
Use node-av for in-process FFmpeg bindings rather than command construction

install.macos: python3 -m pip install typed-ffmpeg (requires FFmpeg separately); TypeScript packages are experimental

assessment.version_seen: Current README documents Python packages and experimental TypeScript packages; release version/date not confirmed
assessment.last_release: unknown (release date not established from pages read)
assessment.rationale: Official README documents typed Python and experimental TypeScript FFmpeg bindings, FFmpeg-version-specific packages and external FFmpeg dependency. The repository identifies MIT licence; current release recency was not established.
